title: Triage Rendezvous
tagline: Compare four task-assignment strategies for minimizing tail latency under bursty arrivals.

curves.label: Random Drop-In
curves.code: for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ let t = Math.floor(Math.random()*m); queue[t].push(req[i]); } // naive dispatch
curves.name: Random Drop-In

curves.label: Join-Shortest-Queue
curves.code: for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ let best=0; for (let k=1;k<m;k++) if (q[k].len<q[best].len) best=k; q[best].push(req[i]); }
curves.name: Join-Shortest-Queue

curves.label: Power-of-Two Choices
curves.code: for (let i=0;i<n;i++){ let a=Math.floor(Math.random()*m), b=Math.floor(Math.random()*m); let t = (q[a].len<=q[b].len)?a:b; q[t].push(req[i]); }
curves.name: Power-of-Two Choices

curves.label: Min-Cost Flow Burst-Batching
curves.code:
/* build batch graph each round: source->workers cap, worker->task edges, run successive shortest augmenting paths */
for (let round=0; round<rounds; round++) { let batch = req.slice(round*B, (round+1)*B); solveMinCostFlow(batch, workers); }
curves.name: Min-Cost Flow Burst-Batching
